verdict.rationale: Mixpanel documents a hosted MCP server that gives AI assistants direct access to project data, including a Create-Dashboard tool that builds a new dashboard with text cards and reports. Its natural-language querying of events, funnels, retention and flows lets an agent work out key metrics before assembling the dashboard. missing for 10: detailed docs on how an agent defines or creates the underlying reports for dashboard cards, any documented REST API path for dashboard creation, and independent or hands-on corroboration of end-to-end agent-built dashboards.
